standards.title: Stainless Steel Utensils for Cooking and Serving - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for stainless steel utensils intended for cooking, serving and storing food, covering grade of steel, thickness, workmanship, finish, freedom from sharp edges and marking.
standards.certification_scheme: Scheme-I (ISI Mark) - voluntary unless notified under a QCO
standards.testing_summary: Chemical composition of the steel, thickness measurement, capacity check, finish and workmanship inspection, and marking verification.
standards.summary_hi: यह मानक खाना पकाने और परोसने के लिए उपयोग होने वाले स्टेनलेस स्टील के बर्तनों की आवश्यकताओं को निर्धारित करता है, जिसमें स्टील का ग्रेड, मोटाई, फिनिश और अंकन शामिल हैं।
standards.summary_bn: এই মানটি রান্না ও পরিবেশনের জন্য ব্যবহৃত স্টেইনলেস স্টিলের বাসনপত্রের প্রয়োজনীয়তা নির্ধারণ করে, যার মধ্যে স্টিলের গ্রেড, পুরুত্ব, ফিনিশ এবং চিহ্নিতকরণ অন্তর্ভুক্ত।

standards.title: Stainless Steel Sheets and Strips for Utensils - Specification
standards.scope: Covers the grades, chemical composition, mechanical properties and surface finish of stainless steel sheets and strips used as the raw material for utensils and food-contact articles.
standards.testing_summary: Chemical analysis, tensile test, bend test, surface finish and dimensional tolerance checks.

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Part 1: General Requirements
standards.scope: General safety requirements for electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, covering protection against electric shock, heating, mechanical hazards, insulation resistance, electric strength and marking.
standards.testing_summary: Insulation resistance, electric strength, leakage current, temperature rise, earthing continuity, mechanical strength and marking durability.
standards.summary_hi: यह मानक घरेलू और समान विद्युत उपकरणों के लिए सामान्य सुरक्षा आवश्यकताएँ निर्धारित करता है, जिसमें विद्युत झटके से सुरक्षा, तापन, इन्सुलेशन प्रतिरोध और अंकन शामिल हैं।
standards.summary_bn: এই মানটি গৃহস্থালি ও অনুরূপ বৈদ্যুতিক যন্ত্রপাতির সাধারণ নিরাপত্তা প্রয়োজনীয়তা নির্ধারণ করে, যার মধ্যে বৈদ্যুতিক শক থেকে সুরক্ষা, উত্তাপ, ইনসুলেশন রেজিস্ট্যান্স ও চিহ্নিতকরণ রয়েছে।

standards.title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Requirements for polyvinyl chloride insulated cables with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to and including 1100 V, used in wiring installations.
standards.certification_scheme: Scheme-I (ISI Mark) - mandatory under the relevant QCO
standards.testing_summary: Conductor resistance, insulation thickness, insulation resistance, high voltage test, tensile and elongation of insulation, flammability and ageing.

standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and including 250 V and Rated Current up to and including 16 A
standards.scope: Requirements for two-pole and three-pole plugs and socket-outlets for household and similar purposes, covering dimensions, protection against electric shock, temperature rise and mechanical strength.
standards.testing_summary: Dimensional check with gauges, protection against shock, insulation resistance and electric strength, temperature rise, breaking capacity, normal operation and mechanical strength.

standards.title: Grading, Marking and Identification of Gold and Gold Alloys - Jewellery and Artefacts
standards.scope: Specifies the grades (caratage) of gold and gold alloys used in jewellery and artefacts, together with the requirements for grading, marking and identification.
standards.certification_scheme: Hallmarking - registration of jeweller with BIS
standards.testing_summary: Assaying of gold purity at a BIS recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre, fineness determination and marking verification.
standards.summary_hi: यह मानक आभूषणों में प्रयुक्त सोने और सोने की मिश्र धातुओं के ग्रेड (कैरेट), अंकन और पहचान की आवश्यकताएँ निर्धारित करता है।
standards.summary_bn: এই মানটি গহনায় ব্যবহৃত সোনা ও সোনার সংকর ধাতুর গ্রেড (ক্যারেট), চিহ্নিতকরণ ও শনাক্তকরণের প্রয়োজনীয়তা নির্ধারণ করে।

standards.title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery and Artefacts - Assaying - Methods of Test
standards.scope: Methods for determining the gold content of jewellery and artefacts, including cupellation (fire assay) and non-destructive X-ray fluorescence screening.
standards.testing_summary: Fire assay (cupellation) as the referee method; XRF used for screening.

standards.title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery and Artefacts - Fineness and Marking
standards.scope: Grades of fineness for silver and silver alloys used in jewellery and artefacts and the corresponding marking requirements.
standards.certification_scheme: Hallmarking - registration of jeweller with BIS
standards.testing_summary: Fineness determination at a recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre and verification of the applied marks.

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for packaged drinking water, covering the source, treatment, physical and chemical limits, microbiological limits, packaging and marking.
standards.testing_summary: Physical and chemical parameters, heavy metals, pesticide residues, microbiological testing and packaging material compliance.

standards.title: Drinking Water - Specification
standards.scope: Acceptable and permissible limits for physical, chemical, toxic-substance and microbiological parameters of drinking water supplied for human consumption.
standards.testing_summary: Turbidity, pH, TDS, hardness, heavy metals, residual chlorine and microbiological parameters.

standards.title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
standards.scope: Requirements and test methods for mechanical and physical properties of toys, including small parts, sharp edges and points, and the hazards they present to children.
standards.certification_scheme: Scheme-I (ISI Mark) - mandatory under the Toys QCO
standards.testing_summary: Small parts cylinder test, sharp edge and point tests, drop and impact tests, torque and tension tests.

standards.title: Protective Helmets for Motorcycle Riders - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for protective helmets worn by riders and pillion riders of motorcycles, covering construction, shock absorption, penetration resistance, retention system and field of vision.
standards.testing_summary: Shock absorption, penetration resistance, retention system strength, peripheral vision and labelling checks.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for ordinary Portland cement of grades 33, 43 and 53, covering chemical and physical requirements, packing and marking.
standards.testing_summary: Fineness, setting time, soundness, compressive strength at 3, 7 and 28 days, and chemical composition.

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services
standards.scope: Safety and performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps intended for general lighting, including marking, insulation resistance, electric strength and photometric performance.
standards.testing_summary: Insulation resistance, electric strength, luminous flux, colour rendering index, power factor and endurance.
